jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, AWS Worldwide Public Sector Engineering (WWPSE)
jobs.description:
Description

This is a role for someone who wants to own outcomes, not just track them. You'll embed directly with the sales leaders who own a public sector market, working backwards from their top priorities to decide where engineering can change the outcome - and getting a high-caliber engineering team into the room early, before problems become escalations. It's a seat with real access: you'll build trusted relationships with senior sales and solution leaders, shape what gets built, and see your work accelerate how governments, healthcare and research organizations, educational institutions, and mission-critical agencies adopt the cloud and AI.

What Sets This Role Apart

You partner upstream with the leaders who own a market - working backwards from their biggest priorities rather than waiting for work to be handed down.
You own engineering engagements end-to-end - from deciding what's worth building, through delivery, to handing a finished solution off to the customer or partner who will run with it.
You work at the intersection of Sales, Solution Architecture, and Engineering, and you're the one who drives where engineering capacity creates the most impact.
You measure success by scaled impact - solutions that many customers can reuse - not one-off projects.
You'll co-build alongside AWS service teams and partners on problems that genuinely can't be solved any other way, using AI both to accelerate how we build and to deliver AI-powered solutions to customers.

If you're customer obsessed, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by turning "this can't be done" into "here's how we did it," we'd love to talk.

Key job responsibilities

Anticipate where your vertical is heading and shape strategy, getting engineering involved early where it makes the biggest difference - including where AI is the critical path
Own the qualification mechanism that drives which opportunities receive engineering investment, weighing scale, reuse, complexity, time-to-impact, and delivery risk
Set and apply the bar that qualifies an engagement - scalability, reusability, multi-customer applicability, force-multiplier potential - and make the hard calls on those that don't clear it
Work side by side with engineers through the build, making the architecture, scoping, and tradeoff decisions that determine success - you own the technical outcome, not just the schedule
Drive co-build execution with AWS Service Teams and Partners, applying AI to accelerate delivery and create reusable patterns that benefit many customers
Own delivery end-to-end from qualification through transfer, resolving technical and cross-team ambiguity without escalation
Keep leadership current on investments, outcomes, and realized impact
Influence peers and partner teams, and mentor less-experienced engineers and program managers

About The Team

AWS Worldwide Public Sector Engineering (WWPSE) is a field-deployed engineering and AI team that unblocks top public sector priorities - helping partners scale, reinforcing AWS Service Teams, and building solutions that endure.

You'll be an embedded engineering lead in one of our verticals - US Federal (FedFin, FedCiv), Healthcare & Life Sciences, or State/Local Government & Education - working across Sales, Solution Architecture, and Engineering, and applying AI to how we build and what we deliver.

This is a hands-on delivery role, not a coordination one: you're in the build with engineers, making the technical calls, accountable for the outcome.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

4+ years of technical product or program management experience
4+ years of software development experience
4+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open-source projects, and/or version control systems
Experience working cross-functionally and driving decision making among stakeholders with competing goals

Preferred Qualifications

4+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience in the public sector
Experience in co-build or joint development models with service teams, ISV partners, or SI partners
Experience qualifying and prioritizing engineering investments based on scale potential and business impact (vs. bespoke, single-customer delivery)
Familiarity with engineer capacity planning, portfolio prioritization frameworks, and deployable unit-style resource allocation models
Experience surfacing technical impact through business metrics and sales operating rhythms

ow do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Prime Air is the place for you.

Come work on the Amazon Prime Air Team!

Key job responsibilities

Architect the World & Missions: Drive the technical program lifecycle for systems responsible for building comprehensive world models, mission planning engines, and dynamic airspace environments. You will ensure our drones navigate a rich, real-time representation of the physical and regulatory world.

Scale for Global Expansion: As we expand operations to numerous new sites globally, you will own the program strategy for scaling these systems. You will ensure our software architectures, data pipelines, and deployment frameworks can seamlessly handle a massive multi-site footprint without compromising reliability or safety.

Drive Technology Roadmaps: Look around corners to define, influence, and execute 3-to-5-year technology roadmaps. You will collaborate closely with Applied Science, Software Engineering, and Hardware teams to align cross-functional technical dependencies and pioneer next-generation autonomous capabilities.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with top-notch developers, systems engineers, safety, and security teams to translate complex technical challenges into execution-ready milestones. You will synthesize ambiguous inputs into crisp technical requirements and drive execution with high ownership.

On a typical day, a Senior TPM bridges high-level strategy and deep technical execution. You’ll kick off by aligning cross-functional tech roadmaps with engineering leaders, unblocking a mission-planning bottleneck, and refining architecture to support our next ten operational sites. We are a high-performing, multidisciplinary organization of applied scientists, software development engineers, and systems engineers who are redefining the future of flight. jobs.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX News Media is seeking an experienced Broadcast & Media Technology Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives across studio operations, live broadcast production, contribution/transmission networks, Media Asset Management (MAM) pipelines, and fast-turnaround content creation/editing environments.

This role will manage projects from initial discovery and technical requirements gathering through solution delivery, systems integration, testing, commissioning, and transition to 24/7 broadcast operations. The successful candidate will collaborate closely across broadcast engineering, studio operations, control rooms, post-production, editorial, transmission, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and external systems integrators/vendors.

The ideal candidate combines disciplined project management practices with a strong technical understanding of how broadcast content moves from field capture/ingest through studio control rooms, non-linear editing (NLE) suites, central MAM repositories, master control/playout, and multi-path transmission.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES

Project Delivery and Governance

Lead the full project lifecycle, including discovery, scoping, technical design coordination, procurement, installation, integration, testing, commissioning, cutover, hypercare, and operational handover.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering work breakdown structures, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, hardware/software lead times, risks, issues, and capital/operating budgets.
Establish governance routines, engineering working sessions, steering committee reporting, and change-control decision forums.
Coordinate workstreams across broadcast engineering, studio tech, transmission/traffic, newsroom operations, editing/post-production, IT infrastructure, and third-party vendors/systems integrators.
Track delivery against broadcast milestones, schedule, budget, quality standards, and operational-readiness criteria.
Maintain rigorous project documentation, including functional specs, system schematics coordination, rack elevations, acceptance test plans (ATP), cutover runbooks, and handover documentation.

Broadcast & Media Technology Delivery

Lead initiatives involving production switchers, audio consoles, studio cameras, robotics, multi-viewers, tally/intercom systems (e.g., Riedel, RTS), broadcast graphics (e.g., Vizrt), and virtual/augmented reality studio tech.
Oversee deployments for field acquisition, bonded cellular (e.g., LiveU, Dejero), satellite/fiber contribution, IP contribution protocols (SRT, RIST, Zixi), and baseband/IP ingest pipelines.
Manage MAM implementations, metadata schema standardization, ingest automation, nearline/deep archive tiers, LTO/cloud storage lifecycles, and media supply chain orchestration.
Drive technical delivery for non-linear editing (NLE) platforms (Adobe Premiere, Avid Media Composer), shared production storage (SAN/NAS/Isilon/Avid NEXIS), fast-turnaround news editing, and transcode/QC workflows.
Coordinate projects for playout automation, routing matrices (SDI and IP), primary/backup transmission paths, satellite uplink/downlink, terrestrial fiber circuits, and disaster recovery (DR) facilities.
Facilitate technical integration between newsroom systems (e.g., iNEWS, ENPS), rundown automation, prompters, and playback servers.
Translate operational and editorial requirements into clear engineering workstreams and technical deliverables.
Support infrastructure modernization and technology refreshes, such as SDI-to-ST 2110 IP transitions, cloud-assisted production, and hybrid on-prem/cloud workflows.
Coordinate technical design reviews alongside Principal Engineers, Systems Architects, and Technical Leads.

Live Operations, Commissioning & Deployment Readiness

Plan and direct factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), end-to-end rehearsal workflows, operational shadow periods, cutovers, and rollback strategies.
Schedule and oversee maintenance windows and deployment sequencing to ensure zero disruption to on-air linear feeds and 24/7 live studio operations.
Partner with Broadcast Operations and Engineering teams to establish support escalation models, monitoring/telemetry dashboards, signal path redundancies, runbooks, and SOPs.
Coordinate comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer for operators, directors, editors, engineers, and technicians prior to on-air cutover.

Technology Modernization & Continuous Improvement

Partner with engineering leads to evaluate emerging broadcast standards (SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, NDI) and cloud/virtualized production platforms.
Identify workflow bottlenecks in the content creation and turnaround pipeline, introducing automation for ingest, transcode, QC, and archiving.
Promote standard operating procedures and best-practice deployment frameworks across all broadcast and studio facilities.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Media Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical industry experience.
Technology project management experience, with experience directly managing broadcast engineering, studio facility, transmission, or media production technology projects.
Proven track record leading projects through technical scoping, RFP/vendor evaluation, rack/facility buildout, systems integration, commissioning, and on-air cutover.
Demonstrated working knowledge across core broadcast domains, including:
Studio production, PCR/TCR control rooms, routing, and intercom systems.
Live contribution (SRT, RIST, ASI, Satellite, Fiber) and transmission pipelines.
MAM systems, automated transcode engines, and shared editing storage (SAN/NAS).
Post-production and NLE workflows (Avid, Adobe, automated QC).
Newsroom Computer Systems (NRCS) and broadcast automation/playout.

Solid grasp of broadcast video/audio signals and protocols (Baseband SDI, SMPTE ST 2110, AES67, Dante, PTP timing, MPEG-TS).
Experience coordinating structured acceptance testing (FAT/SAT) and high-stakes, off-hours facility cutovers with tight change-window constraints.
Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Visio/Lucidchart).
Exceptional communication, leadership, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to bridge conversations between on-air talent/editorial teams and deep technical engineering specialists.
Experience leading facility buildouts, studio relocations, or control room overhauls.
Practical knowledge of IP media network architecture (SMPTE ST 2110, ST 2022-6/7, NMOS IS-04/IS-05).
Experience with broadcast equipment vendors and platforms (e.g., Grass Valley, Evertz, Ross Video, Sony, Avid, Imagine Communications, Vizrt, Harmonic, Telestream).
Familiarity with hybrid/cloud-based media workflows in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience managing external Systems Integrators (SIs) and broadcast equipment hardware vendors.
Relevant industry certifications: PMP, CAPM, or technical broadcast certifications (e.g., SBE - Society of Broadcast Engineers certifications).

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.

Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.

Education And Experience

- When you join GAR, you join something bigger. Big in scale, big in opportunities to grow, and big in impact. Here, your career feeds something meaningful – for the planet, for people and for generations to come.

jobs.description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

Business Unit Overview

Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTI) is the technology team at the core of each of Blackstone's businesses and new growth initiatives. Serving both internal and external clients, we work to build the next generation of systems that manage risk, create efficiency and improve transparency within the firm and across our broad community of investors and portfolio companies.

BXTI is entrepreneurial – our open, iterative design processes and rapid pace of development mean that everyone on the team has the opportunity to make an impact from day one. We are problem solvers who can take projects from idea to implementation. We believe in active mentoring and developing excellence. We collaborate to find the best answers for our customers and for our firm.

Position Overview

The Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) team within Blackstone Security Operations identifies, tracks, and assesses cyber threats relevant to Blackstone and its portfolio companies. The Associate Threat Intelligence Analyst conducts tactical, operational, and strategic analysis to inform defensive operations, risk decisions, and executive awareness. This is a team at the cutting edge of cyber defense: we are pioneering the use of AI and automation to outpace adversaries, we move quickly from idea to production, and we give analysts real ownership to shape how intelligence is practiced rather than slot into a routine. This is hands-on intelligence and engineering work: monitoring the evolving threat landscape, producing finished intelligence products and reports, extracting and enriching indicators of compromise (IOCs), and helping manage the firm's external attack surface and exposure risk. The analyst leverages AI and automation tooling to collect, enrich, and operationalize intelligence at scale, and develops clear visual products such as diagrams to make threats understandable to both technical and non-technical audiences. The role works closely with detection engineering, incident response, and vulnerability management to turn intelligence into new detections and preventions, helping protect one of the world's leading investment platforms where cybersecurity and global finance meet.

Responsibilities

Monitor and analyze cyber threat activity targeting the financial sector, alternative asset management, and adjacent industries using open-source, commercial, and internal sources, correlating across them to identify patterns and provide early warning of emerging campaigns
Produce finished intelligence products and reports including recurring threat reporting, advisories, campaign profiles, actor dossiers, executive briefings, and visual products such as diagrams, tailored to both technical and non-technical audiences
Map adversary behaviors to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and maintain threat actor profiles covering TTPs, intent, and relevance to Blackstone
Extract, validate, enrich, and operationalize indicators of compromise (IOCs) to support detection engineering and incident response workflows
Leverage AI and automation tooling to scale collection, enrichment, and operationalization of intelligence
Partner with Alert, Detection & Response and Incident Response teams to translate intelligence into production detections (Splunk SPL, Sigma, YARA)
Track zero-day and critical vulnerabilities, assess Blackstone's exposure, and translate findings into new detections and preventions in coordination with detection and security engineering
Support threat-informed vulnerability prioritization (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV) and coordinate remediation tracking with asset owners
Operate and evolve the firm's external Attack Surface Management (ASM) program, discovering and inventorying internet-facing assets across Blackstone and its portfolio companies, triaging newly discovered exposures and misconfigurations, and coordinating remediation
Support Fusion Center digital-threat monitoring, including brand, executive, and reputational exposure across OSINT, social media, and dark web sources
Contribute to intelligence sharing with trusted industry partners, ISACs (such as FS-ISAC), government partners (such as JCDC), and peer financial institutions
Participate in incident response and the SOC on-call rotation (occasional, roughly every other month) to respond to escalated security incidents

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in cyber threat intelligence, security operations, incident response, or a related cybersecurity discipline
Demonstrated understanding of the cyber threat landscape, including prominent threat actor groups,

campaigns, and TTPs

Working knowledge of intelligence frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, or the Intelligence Cycle
Experience with threat intelligence platforms (TIPs), SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk), OSINT research methodologies, or attack surface management / vulnerability management tooling
Scripting or programming experience (Python preferred) for automating data collection, enrichment, and analytic workflows
Demonstrated, hands-on experience applying AI tooling (such as LLMs and coding assistants) to real work, and can clearly speak to several projects where you used AI to automate or accelerate a task
Capable of writing clearly and developing visual products (such as diagrams) to communicate complex cyber threats to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive leadership
Strong analytical reasoning, attention to detail, and capable of prioritizing effectively in a fast-paced environment
B.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Intelligence Studies, International Relations, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the financial sector or an organization with a global threat landscape
Hands-on experience with Attack Surface Management platforms (e.g., Mandiant ASM, CrowdStrike Falcon Surface, Microsoft Defender EASM, or similar)
Hands-on experience with specific AI developer tooling, such as LLM assistants and APIs (e.g., ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, Gemini), coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor), or agentic and automation frameworks
Experience with vulnerability management programs, including prioritization frameworks (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV) and remediation tracking
Familiarity with structured analytic techniques and intelligence writing standards
Experience with detection content development (Sigma, YARA, Splunk SPL, or KQL)
Active participation in industry working groups, ISACs, or CTI community forums
Relevant certifications (GIAC GCTI, Security+, CTIA, or similar)
Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure) and an understanding of cloud-specific threat vectors

Introduction

PLEASE FILL OUT THE APPLICATION COMPLETELY.

We encourage you to consider an exciting career with the Maryland Department of the Environment (MDE). If you are dedicated to protecting and preserving Maryland's air, water, land resources, and safeguarding the health of all its citizens, we invite you to apply and become a part of our team.

MDE is committed to a mission of protecting and restoring the environment for the health and well-being of all Marylanders, with a vision of healthy, vibrant, and sustainable communities and ecosystems throughout the state.

To learn more about MDE Click Here .

GRADE

22

LOCATION OF POSITION

Maryland Department of the Environment

Water and Science Administration

Compliance Program,

1800 Washington Blvd.

Baltimore, MD 21230

Main Purpose of Job

The Deputy Program Manager will be responsible for enforcing State laws and regulations through the management and administration of numerous regulatory services. Through the application of high-level technical and policy expertise, the incumbent will manage compliance services, field monitoring activities, regulatory compliance, and legal enforcement functions associated with industrial pretreatment; NPDES/State discharge permits; tidal and nontidal wetland permits and licenses; sediment and erosion control approvals; stormwater management approvals; appropriation permits; well and septic system approvals; and waterway and dam construction permits. The WSA Compliance Program is one of the most diverse and complex programs within MDE.

Key responsibilities include developing and implementing compliance policies, managing sensitive and controversial enforcement issues, negotiating enforcement actions with clients and/or violators, and supervising a large and diverse workforce. The Deputy Program Manager will also oversee the program’s day-to-day activities, including approving requisitions and managing procurements.

The incumbent will be required to drive a State vehicle. If you hold an out-of-state driver’s license, you must provide a certified copy of your driving record from the issuing state’s Motor Vehicle Administration at the time of hire. All individuals must maintain a driver's license with no more than 5 points on their driving record to operate a State vehicle.

Minimum Qualifications

EDUCATION:
Possession of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university that includes 30 credits in engineering, biological, environmental, physical sciences or other appropriate technical education, or possession of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Environmental Law or Environmental Public Policy or other appropriate related degree.

EXPERIENCE:
Six (6) years of experience supervising a professional staff in an environmental field or experience as an environmental project manager including assigning tasks, setting priorities, and reviewing work products.

Notes

Professional or scientific experience related to natural resources, environment or public health may be substituted on a year-for-year basis for education.
Registration as a Professional Engineer may be substituted for the required education.
One additional year of experience in professional scientific, natural resources, or environmental or public health may be substituted for the 30 specialized academic credits.

Desired Or Preferred Qualifications

Please note that your answers to the supplemental questionnaire must correspond to the information provided on your application to receive credit.

It is preferred that the selected candidate has the following:

jobs.description:
In PACCAR, the need exists to have individuals who provide guidance on information security. The Senior Information Security Analyst must be technically savvy in the information security field, have a broad IT background, be or quickly become familiar with PACCAR systems, networks and IT processes and be able to perform independent research on security vulnerabilities. The individual will be recognized as a Subject Matter expert on security.

Job Functions/Responsibilities

Advise on risks associated with given solutions including, but not limited to:
Network, OS, Hardware, Application, Software Coding, Architecture.

Advise on legal and regulatory statutes (Nationally and Internationally) such as:
HIPPA, PCI, SOX, FRCP, GLB, State Privacy Laws, European Privacy Directive, Safe Harbor Provision, etc.

Develop and advise on security architecture.
Assist with development of global security strategies.
Help develop and refine a secure cloud architecture approach.
Research and evaluate findings on security vulnerabilities.
Research and develop options to mitigate or remove risk.
Conduct investigations using forensics tools.
Support eDiscovery efforts for litigation response.
Support and enhance incident response process.
Provide guidance on balancing business needs vs exposure/risk.
Develop standards for information security.
Develop security metrics/KPIs that have business relevance.
Mentor others in Information Security roles.
Present findings and recommendations to varying levels, including upper management.
Prepare positioning papers for PACCAR related to information security.
Speak for the Chief Information Security Officer on security matters as required.
Willingness to speak on security at various events, conferences or local colleges.

Qualifications

8+ years of broad based IT experience.
Knowledge of security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, or CIS Controls.
Familiarity with security tools (e.g., firewalls, intrusion detection systems, SIEM).
Experience with vulnerability management and incident response.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

jobs.title: Mission Operations Analyst and Planner
jobs.description:
Job Number: R0247700

Mission Operations Analyst and Planner

The Opportunity:

As an expert in defense missions, your unique background inspires you to think bigger, push further, and ask questions others don’t. We need your extensive industry knowledge and advisory skills to solve some of our clients’ most complex problems—and find solutions that keep our nation safe.

As a Mission Operations Analyst and Planner ,
you’ll bring your technical expertise to work alongside thought leaders in analyzing, designing and planning mission operations on projects for a high-profile customer.

You’ll use your skills and expertise to conduct highly responsive mission planning support services as a part of a dedicated, client-site operational support team that enables the execution of dynamic mission requirements on a global basis. Develop and coordinate tailored mission planning packages, conduct suitability studies for destination airfields, and coordinate diplomatic clearances. Maintain a collaborative relationships to ensure continuous support is provided through the mission planning, execution, and data archiving phases of each mission. Maintain flexible work hours to accommodate all mission scenarios and provide uninterrupted operational support. Provide inputs to monthly mission planning support summaries to convey relevant statistical mission planning support data for client reference. Attend DoW and Industry sponsored mission planning conferences as necessary to remain abreast of advances in mission planning and dispatch processes.

Work with us to help solve our customer's most complex mission area focused challenges.
You served your country—now, continue your mission with us. Further your career while creating mission-forward solutions that matter.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have: 

5+ years of experience with military or industry rated aviation
5+ years of experience with military or industry mission planning, weather, and aircraft operations
5+ years of experience with aircraft performance, airfield suitability, and Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) analysis
Experience with executive airlift or business aviation operations requirements
Ability to obtain a TS/SCI clearance
Bachelor's degree

Nice If You Have: 

Experience with aviation industry-standard scheduling systems, and mission planning software
Experience with archiving post-flight data records
Master's degree

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your
own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided
.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. The Operations Analyst is responsible for defining and performing systems analysis and development tasks to improve workflow and operating efficiency for the USBA Operations Life Events Department. The Life Events teams main functions are to administer and process journals for beneficiary claims and day to day asset movement between internal USBA client accounts. The analyst formulates proposals for new systems and information needs by analyzing existing systems and procedures and defining recommended technical and procedural improvements. Typically three or more years of relevant experience

Thorough knowledge of policies, plans, procedures, products and regulatory requirements for the brokerage industry
Ability to conduct an analysis of a business need, including scheduling meetings, planning agendas and conferring with business line leaders

Ability to develop test schedules, review testing plans, track test issues and report on test results
Strong analytical and forecasting skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects and deadlines simultaneously
Ability to work as part of a project team
Effective verbal and written presentation and communication skills

Securities 7 and 24 Licenses

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart’s Catalog Operations team powers the data that makes shopping effortless. Catalog data represents the vast majority of what customers see when they browse, search, and buy. Our quality, coverage, and accuracy directly shape the customer experience. We are an AI-first operations team that builds LLM-driven pipelines and scalable quality programs to create, enrich, and govern product data across the Instacart ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Catalog Operations Analyst II to accelerate our Health and Meals pillar within Online Grocery, one of our top strategic priorities. In this role, you will drive end-to-end data quality and enrichment for health, nutrition, and meal-related attributes, partnering closely with Catalog Engineering, Data Science, Product, and ML, as well as external data providers and BPOs. You’ll join a tight-knit team of 8 who roll up their sleeves, solve creatively, and deliver measurable impact at scale.

This role is based in Canada and is remote-eligible nationwide, with a preference for candidates located in Ontario (ideally Greater Toronto Area) for periodic in-person collaboration.

About The Job

Own data quality outcomes for the Health and Meals pillar by defining accuracy and coverage goals for critical attributes (e.g., nutrition, dietary tags, allergens, preparation/meal context) and driving measurable improvements across the catalog.
Design, test, and operationalize LLM pipelines in partnership with Catalog Engineering and ML, including prompt iterations, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop QA.
Develop robust SQL analyses to monitor health of the catalog, identify root causes, prioritize fixes, and communicate performance and impact to cross-functional stakeholders.
Establish and continuously refine taxonomies, attribute definitions, and normalization standards; author SOPs and quality guidelines that scale across internal teams, external content providers, and BPOs.
Manage day-to-day execution with external vendors and data partners (e.g. BPOs), setting SLAs, creating QA workflows, and implementing sampling plans that improve precision and recall at scale.
Partner with Product, DS, and XFN teams to scope experiments, validate assumptions, and translate insights into roadmaps that elevate discovery, search relevance, and conversion for health and meal oriented use cases.

This is a fast-paced, evolving environment. You’ll thrive if you enjoy ambiguity, take ownership from problem definition through execution, and communicate clearly to align diverse partners on outcomes.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

3+ years of experience in catalog/content operations, data operations, or data quality within e-commerce, marketplace, retail, or a similar high-scale data environment.
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, analytical, or related field (e.g., Data/Information Science, Business, Economics, Statistics) or equivalent practical experience.
Demonstrated success partnering with Engineering, Data Science, and Product to scope requirements and deliver production-scale projects.
Proficiency in SQL (including joins, aggregations, and window functions) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets for analysis, QA sampling, and reporting.
Familiarity with LLMs and prompt design for data extraction, classification, or attribute enrichment, including LLM evaluation and feedback loops.
Hands-on experience defining and managing data quality metrics (e.g., accuracy, precision, recall) and running root cause analyses.
Experience operationalizing workflows with external vendors/BPOs or data providers, including SOPs, SLAs, and multi-step QA processes.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) in your day to day.
Experience with data wrangling, QA automation, and scaling manual processes.
Experience building dashboards in Looker, Tableau, or Mode to track operational and quality KPIs.
Track record of delivering results in dynamic, ambiguous environments while communicating effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
Background in ecommerce, grocery/CPG data, or technology/startups.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

Role Description
We are seeking an analytical, curious, and data-driven Data Analyst / Junior Data Analyst to transform raw business data into actionable insights, clear reports, and intuitive visual dashboards. In this entry-to-junior level position, you will work closely with Senior Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and Department Leads to support data collection, data cleaning, quantitative analysis, and performance tracking across business units. You will be responsible for querying relational databases, identifying trends and operational anomalies, building automated dashboards, and presenting data insights to non-technical stakeholders. Responsibilities include maintaining data integrity across core datasets, standardizing recurring reporting schedules, performing ad-hoc statistical analyses, and assisting in business process optimization. Success in this position requires strong logical reasoning, high mathematical accuracy, proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools, introductory knowledge of scripting languages, and the ability to translate technical metrics into clear business narratives.

Education:
Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Business Information Systems, or a related quantitative field.
Database & SQL Querying:
Solid foundational knowledge of relational databases and proficient SQL skills (SELECT, GROUP BY, JOINs, subqueries, CTEs, and aggregate functions) for extracting and manipulating data.
Data Visualization & Business Intelligence (BI):
Practical experience or academic exposure to building interactive dashboards and visual reports using modern BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Qlik).
Spreadsheets & Analytical Modeling:
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, INDEX/MATCH, nested formulas, and data validation rules).

Understanding of basic Data Transformation workflows (ETL/ELT), handling missing data, identifying data outliers, and ensuring data accuracy before analysis.
Statistical Concepts & Business Acumen:
Core grasp of descriptive statistics (mean, median, variance, standard deviation), probability distribution, correlation vs. causation, and key business performance metrics (KPIs).
Ad-hoc & Exploratory Analysis:
Capability to investigate raw datasets, formulate hypothesis tests, uncover operational patterns, and present data-backed recommendations to management.
Communication & Data Storytelling:
Strong written and verbal communication skills to explain complex statistical outputs clearly and present visual dashboards to non-technical business stakeholders.
Professional Attributes:
High analytical curiosity, rigorous attention to numerical accuracy, strong structured problem-solving approach, and an adaptable learning mindset.

jobs.description:
About Berkeley

At the University of California, Berkeley, we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth. We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan, which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride.

Departmental Overview

At UC Berkeley School of Public Health (UCBPH), health equity and social justice are part of our DNA. For more than 75 years, we’ve been pushing boundaries and challenging the status quo. Established in 1943, we are a top-10 national school of public health located on the UC Berkeley campus, comprising six academic divisions, more than 20 graduate programs, and nearly 30 research centers and programs. Our mission is to improve population health, especially for the most vulnerable, and our most cherished values are health as a right; strength through diversity; thinking forward; and impact first. Learn more at: publichealth.berkeley.edu.

The Center for Targeted Machine Learning and Causal Inference (CTML) at UC Berkeley is an interdisciplinary research center for advancing, implementing, and disseminating methodology to address problems arising in public health and clinical medicine. CTML's mission statement is to drive rigorous, transparent, and reproducible science by harnessing cutting-edge causal inference and AI targeted towards robust discoveries, informed decision-making, and improving health.

Position Summary

The Research Data Analyst conducts statistical analyses in support of a domestic HIV prevention research program conducted at three study sites that includes randomized trials and related observational studies. Working under the direction of the lead study statistician, this position implements pre-specified statistical analysis plans in R, contributes analytic content to the drafting of those plans, and prepares tables, figures, and summary reports for study monitoring, manuscripts, and presentations. The Research Data Analyst works routinely with site data managers and study staff at the three sites on data deliveries and analytic requests, exercising judgment within established practices on assignments of moderate scope and complexity.

Application Review Date

The First Review Date for this job is: September 7, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.

Responsibilities

Statistical Analysis - 40%

Implement pre-specified analyses for randomized trials and related studies under the direction of the lead statistician, including descriptive summaries, primary and secondary outcome analyses, and pre-specified sensitivity analyses. Apply established causal inference and machine learning based estimators (for example TMLE and related R packages) using specifications set by the lead statistician. Independently plan and run limited analyses and simulations addressing defined design or power questions.

Analytic Dataset Construction - 20%

Build, document, and maintain pooled analytic datasets from the three site datasets and from Electronic Health Records (EHR) and administrative sources. Write and maintain reproducible derivation code. Specify what is needed from site data managers and verify that delivered data meet analytic requirements.

Analysis Plans and Analytic Documentation - 20%

Contribute to the drafting of statistical analysis plans, including data source descriptions, analytic population and outcome definitions, table and figure shells, and written specification of analyses for review by the lead statistician. Maintain version-controlled code, data dictionaries, and analysis logs so all reported results can be regenerated. Contribute analytic language to protocols and Institutional Review Board (IRB) submissions.

Reporting, Publication, and Presentation Support - 5%

Prepare recurring monitoring reports, DSMB tables, and grant progress reporting for internal study constituents. Produce and format tables and figures for manuscripts, abstracts, and slide presentations to journal, sponsor, and meeting specifications. Run reviewer-requested analyses as specified and assemble supplementary materials.

Site Coordination and Data Requests - 5%

Work routinely with site data managers and study staff at the three sites on data deliveries, variable questions, and turnaround of analytic requests. Respond to enrollment, retention, and cohort description requests from co-investigators and study staff.

Professional Development - 5%

Participates in workshops, trainings, and other professional development activities; may participate in committees, projects, and other service activities.

Other Duties - 5%

Other duties

Required Qualifications

Working knowledge of biostatistical principles and epidemiologic study designs, including randomized controlled trials, observational studies, cohort studies, and longitudinal analyses.
Working Knowledge of established causal inference and machine learning methods (e.g., TMLE, propensity scores, inverse probability weighting) and their application using R.
Working skills in conducting statistical analyses, including descriptive, primary, secondary, sensitivity, and simulation analyses according to predefined statistical analysis plans.
Proficiency in programming with R and developing reproducible, well-documented analytic workflows and statistical code.
Ability to coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary investigators, statisticians, research staff, and collaborating sites to support timely data requests and study deliverables.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to maintain confidentiality, comply with human subjects research regulations, and effectively communicate statistical findings to diverse scientific and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.
Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team.
Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines.
Demonstrated complex problem-solving skills.

Education / Training

Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
Advanced degree in related area (Preferred)

Salary & Benefits

For information on the comprehensive benefits package offered by the University, please visit the University of California's Compensation & Benefits website.

Under California law, the University of California, Berkeley is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role and should not offer a salary outside of the range posted in this job announcement. This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, analysis of internal equity, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be offered a salary at or near the top of the range for a position. Salary offers are determined based on final candidate qualifications and experience.

The budgeted hourly range that the University reasonably expects to pay for this position is $37.57 - $44.89. The the full pay scale for the classification is $37.57 - $66.83.

This is a non-exempt, bi-weekly paid position.
This is a full-time (40 hours/week) Career position eligible for UC benefits.

How To Apply

To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter.

Other Information

This position is eligible for up to 5 days/week of remote work within the United States. Exact arrangements are determined in partnership with your supervisor to meet role responsibilities and department needs and are subject to change.
This is not a visa opportunity. This position does not include sponsorship of a new consular H-1B visa petition that would require payment of the $100,000 supplemental fee.
This position is covered by the collective bargaining agreement between UAW (United Auto Workers) and the University of California Regents for RP or SV.

Description

The Opportunity

KWI keeps specialty retail running for Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and dozens of other brands, and behind every storefront is an engineering team shipping constantly. Today those releases are coordinated on instinct and hallway conversations. You're here to change that. As our Technical Program Manager, you'll own the master release timeline, build the system that keeps every team aligned, and make shipping shorter, smoother, and more predictable, reporting straight to the CTO with a clear mandate to fix what slows us down.

The Company

We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a unified commerce solution that is designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and many other globally recognizable brands.

We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, eCommerce, CRM, and Loss Prevention into one cloud-based platform. We are a Values and Mission driven organization, and we believe that if we develop and demonstrate leadership in our strategy, operations, and people, we will continue to drive product innovation and service excellence.

As the Technical Program Manager, you excel at the following core competencies

Cross-team release coordination
Own the master release timeline across all engineering teams, with a particular focus on the POS release cycle.
Map and track cross-team dependencies; surface conflicts early and drive resolution before they become delays. Facilitate go/no-go checkpoints.
You can approve a go based on readiness data; all no-go decisions escalate to the CTO and Head of Product.
Manage the release calendar so teams on different schedules do not collide. Establish and enforce change control: once scope is locked, late changes require formal approval with an impact assessment

Cross-functional coordination
Define and maintain RACI matrices for release activities across Engineering, QA, Technical Writing, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Run release readiness reviews that include all involved departments, not just engineering.
Serve as the single point of accountability for program-level release status visibility across the organization.

Risk management and escalation
Proactively identify risks to timelines, scope, and quality across all teams.
Maintain a risk register and drive mitigation plans.
Escalate to the CTO and Head of Product when cross-team conflicts cannot be resolved at the team level.

The impact you'll make

Process definition and documentation
Convert tribal knowledge into documented, repeatable processes: release runbooks, checklists, onboarding guides.
Define and maintain the release process end-to-end so it is survivable if any individual is unavailable.
Establish templates for cross-team planning: dependency maps, risk registers, status reports.
Identify bottlenecks and gaps; propose and implement improvements using retrospective data.

Reporting and continuous improvement
Design and own the organization-wide status reporting system: template, cadence, format, and a compilation mechanism so the report assembles itself.
Author program-level status reports directly covering cross-team releases, dependency health, risks, and milestones.
Partner with engineering leadership to mature delivery practices and introduce tooling that improves velocity and visibility.
Establish program-level metrics (cycle time, release predictability, dependency-related delays) and use them to drive improvement.

What you will bring

5 to 9 years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a comparable role coordinating across multiple engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to build and run release coordination at the program level, not just within a single team or project.
Strong technical fluency: you can hold a substantive conversation about architecture, dependencies, and technical risk without needing it simplified for you.
Experience defining and documenting processes from scratch, including runbooks, RACI matrices, and dependency tracking frameworks.
Track record of managing cross-functional stakeholders, including product, QA, marketing, and customer success, through complex releases.
Clear written communication: your status reports give leadership the information they need to make decisions, not a list of what everyone is working on.

Bonus points
Experience in a SaaS company serving retail or enterprise clients.
Familiarity with Kanban-based delivery workflows and how to mature them into more disciplined frameworks.
Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted workflows for delivery visibility or reporting.
Background working closely with a CTO or VP Engineering in a fast-moving product organization.

Full Medical, Dental and Vision
Annual bonus eligible
Free gym in the building
Generous PTO policy
Summer Fridays....all year round
Tuition Reimbursement
Discount from building café
401(K) with a 50% company match (up to 6% of employee base salary)
Employee Referral Program
(1) Volunteer day each year

We understand that our teams need flexibility, which is why we follow a hybrid schedule. Our in-office days of Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, and employees are allowed to work remotely on Wednesdays and Friday.

We are also a collaborative group and believe that getting together in person allows our team to do their best work. Together we enjoy monthly events, bagels every Thursday, a state-of-the-art coffee machine, a full snack pantry and many more surprise and delight moments throughout the year.

jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are the VMS Co-Op, a group of fast growing companies in the Vitamins, Minerals and Supplements (VMS) space. The VMS Co-Op includes OLLY, SmartyPants and future acquisitions to come! This position's home company is OLLY.

THE ROLE: SENIOR ASSOCIATE PROJECT MANAGER

The Sr. Associate Project Manager plays a critical role in supporting the successful planning and execution of creative initiatives across Campaigns, Brand,Packaging, and Innovation. Working closely with Creative, Marketing, Brand Strategy, Commercial, Product Development, Regulatory, and Operations teams, this role helps ensure projects move efficiently from intake through delivery.

This position serves as a key operational partner to the Creative team, managing day-to-day project coordination, timelines, communications, and processes that keep work moving forward. By driving operational excellence across a portfolio of projects, the Sr. Associate Project Manager enables creative teams to focus on delivering impactful work while building the skills and experience necessary to grow into larger project leadership responsibilities.

This role reports to Sr. Manager of Creative Operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Support the management of creative projects from intake through final delivery across Campaigns, Packaging, and Brand initiatives.
Build and maintain project timelines, workbacks, trackers, and project documentation.
Coordinate project kickoffs, status meetings, reviews, approvals, and stakeholder communications.
Track project progress and proactively identify risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks.
Ensure project information, timelines, assets, and deliverables are accurate, organized, and up to date.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, align expectations, and support project execution.
Assist with intake management, project routing, and workflow coordination across the Creative team.
Support resource tracking and workload planning to help balance team capacity and project needs.
Maintain project management systems and reporting tools that provide visibility into active work streams.
Help identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and team efficiency.
Partner with Sr. Project Managers and Creative Operations leaders to support portfolio management and operational excellence.
Contribute to a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture that helps teams do their best work.

THE CANDIDATE - You’re a detail-oriented project manager with a passion for creative excellence.

You enjoy being at the center of the action, helping teams stay organized, informed, and focused on what matters most. You're highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a passion for making complex projects feel manageable.

You thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy collaborating across teams, and know how to keep multiple work streams moving simultaneously. You're comfortable balancing competing priorities, communicating with a variety of stakeholders, and finding solutions when challenges arise.

Most importantly, you're someone who takes ownership, follows through, and genuinely enjoys helping teams work more effectively together.

CAPABILITIES + SKILLS REQUIRED

2-5+ years of experience in project management, creative operations, marketing operations, or related fields.
Experience supporting integrated marketing campaigns, creative development, or brand initiatives.
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Experience building and maintaining timelines, trackers, project plans, and documentation.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple moving pieces with accuracy.
Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities for process improvement.
Experience working with project management tools and systems.
Strong collaboration skills and ability to build relationships across functions.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong follow-through and accountability.
Desire to grow into larger project leadership and operational management responsibilities.

Initial video screen with a member of our Talent team

As an expert in defense missions, your unique background inspires you to think bigger, push further, and ask questions others don’t. We need your extensive industry knowledge and advisory skills to solve some of our clients’ most complex problems—and find solutions that keep our nation safe.

Bachelor's degree

jobs.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

This is a full-time, flexible hybrid position based out of our Oakland, CA office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration. There is no mandate on the number of days required but we encourage employees to come in every week to collaborate.

About This Role

We're hiring a Senior Data Analyst, Revenue
to support our CFO and Finance organization on some of the most complex and consequential analytical problems at Fivetran. This role sits at the intersection of finance, data, and applied mathematics, with a focus on understanding, forecasting, and modeling the economic engine of the business.

You'll develop sophisticated models for revenue attribution, forecasting, customer behavior, and financial performance; build the underlying data infrastructure that powers company-wide reporting; and partner directly with Finance and executive leadership on decisions that shape the business.

This is a highly quantitative role for someone with exceptional numerical intuition, rigorous logical thinking, and an unusually high bar for accuracy. You'll work on problems where small errors can have meaningful downstream consequences, and where the best solution often requires going beyond standard reporting into mathematical modeling, statistical methods, or machine learning.

If you enjoy decomposing ambiguous business problems into precise mathematical frameworks, stress-testing assumptions, and building models that become foundational to how a company operates, this role offers the opportunity to work on some of our hardest analytical challenges.

Technologies You'll Use

SQL (BigQuery / Snowflake)
dbt / dbt State
Looker / LookML
Sigma / Hex / Google Sheets
Claude Code / Codex
Netsuite, CRM, and customer data and billing systems

What You'll Do

Develop sophisticated revenue models. Build, maintain, and improve complex mathematical models used to project, attribute, analyze, and understand Fivetran's revenue, customers, and underlying business drivers. Work in an environment with a strong emphasis on mathematical reasoning, robust logic, numerical precision, and analytical rigor.
Own revenue attribution and financial logic. Design frameworks that accurately connect revenue to customers, products, contracts, usage, and other business dimensions, including complex attribution problems that require careful mathematical treatment.
Build and improve revenue forecasting. Develop models that project revenue and customer behavior using historical trends, leading indicators, statistical methods, and machine learning. Continuously evaluate forecast accuracy and improve model performance over time.
Build scalable analytical infrastructure. Create data models, pipelines, and automated systems that are reliable, optimized, and scalable, enabling timely analytics and reporting for more than 2,000 stakeholders across the company.
Maintain an exceptionally high bar for quality. Develop rigorous validation, testing, and quality-assurance processes for financial data and analytical models. Identify edge cases, challenge assumptions, and ensure outputs can withstand scrutiny from Finance and executive leadership.
Partner closely with Finance leadership. Work directly with the CFO organization and cross-functional leaders to translate complex business questions into analytical frameworks, define business rules, establish metrics and targets, and communicate findings clearly.
Drive executive-level decision making. Conduct high-impact, in-depth analyses that inform company strategy, financial planning, resource allocation, growth initiatives, and other critical business decisions.
Embody ownership and operational excellence. Take responsibility for the correctness and reliability of your work, continuously improve existing systems and methodologies, and raise the analytical bar for the broader team.

Skills We're Looking For

4+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience working across large, complex datasets
Exceptional quantitative ability and numerical intuition, with a strong foundation in mathematics, logic, statistics, and analytical problem-solving
Experience using Looker, Tableau, Sigma, or similar business intelligence and visualization tools
Strong analytical judgment and a track record of translating ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data quality, analytical rigor, and reproducibility
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills; you can make complex findings intuitive and help decision-makers understand not just what is happening, but why it matters and what to do next
Comfort operating in ambiguity, developing hypotheses, and owning analytical problems end-to-end
Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to build trusted relationships with both technical and non-technical partners
A builder mindset: you look beyond answering one-off questions and create frameworks, datasets, and tools that make future decisions faster and better
Passion for using data to improve how organizations attract, develop, and support their people
Experience using analytics to support key business decisions, preferably at a high-growth, SaaS, or B2B product company

Description And Requirements

ABOUT WCG:
WCG’s clinical solutions are built on a foundation of best-in-class clinical services companies. We deliver transformational solutions that stimulate growth, foster compliance, and maximize efficiency for those performing clinical trials. WCG is proud to serve individuals on the frontlines of science and medicine, and the organizations striving to develop new products and therapies to improve the quality of human health. It is our role to empower them to accelerate advancement, while ensuring the risks of progress never outweigh the value of human life.

WHY WE LOVE WCG:
At WCG, our employees are our most valuable asset and as with all our assets, we invest in them with an eye toward future success. We provide each eligible employee with a comprehensive set of benefits designed to protect their personal and financial health and to help them make the most of their future.

Comprehensive Benefits package - Health, Dental, Vision, Life Disability, 401k with match, and flexible spending accounts
Employee Assistance Programs and additional work/life resources
Referral Bonuses and Tuition Reimbursement
Flexible PTO
Volunteer Time Off to benefit the community
Opportunities for career development with on-the-job training, certification assistance and continuing education reimbursement

JOB SUMMARY:
The Project Manager Client Delivery is responsible for the day-to-day management of client projects and ensures that projects are delivered on time, within budget and according to the agreed upon scope of work. The Project Manager Client Delivery will serve as the bridge between our clients, internal teams, and partners to manage the operational execution of projects.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The accountabilities listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.

Leads as an operational interface between the client and Company for project/service solutions.
Oversees moderate to complex programs and projects which includes management of tasks for solution planning, analysis, configuration, and execution.
Facilitates implementing business and system process best practices.
Manages relationship with business and executive stakeholders (internal and external).
Undertakes strategy creation for contingency planning and risk mitigation.
Plans and schedules project goals, milestones, and deliverables.
Creates and manages project plans and timelines.

Aligns project objectives with company goals and ensures project team is clear on objectives.

Demos the technology in proposed solutions to clients and others, where applicable.
Articulates design rationale and function strategy throughout the life of the project if new client or technical requirements necessitate new design or function strategy.

Obtains, discusses, and follows through with client feedback.
Works with client for change orders as required for the lifecycle of the project.
Anticipates, investigates, and answers clients’ questions.
Supports and helps troubleshoot delivered work during project and post-project.
Ensures client expectations are met and exceeded in terms of quality of product and service delivered.
Manages project team members with regard to assigned tasks on those projects – team members are matrixed in for project assignments.
Other duties as assigned by supervisor. These may, on occasion, be unrelated to the position described here.

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education, skills, and experience to perform the job.

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSE/REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS:
PMP certification desired.

Qualifications/Experience

Proven project management experience. Must have at least three (3) years of demonstrated experience managing all stages of project-life cycle, from developing complete project plans and executing the management and implementation of those plans on time and within budget.
Experience working with CRO, pharmaceutical company, or other centralized service provider used in clinical studies a plus.
Strong financial acumen required. Demonstrated knowledge of financial management and forecasting skills.
Knowledge of project management software tools and management techniques.
Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to manage, motivate, and handle a client.
Excellent problem solving/decision making skills.
Outstanding written and oral communication skills.
Excellent organizational and planning skills with the ability to utilize technology and tools to enhance the effectiveness of deliverables and service.

Excellent interpersonal skills. Ability to lead through influencing and negotiating.

About the Role

We're looking for a fully remote Ad Operations Project Manager to oversee the end-to-end workflow for a high-volume ad build operation. This role is responsible for managing intake, prioritization, assignment, quality control, and launch readiness across a fast-moving queue of digital advertising projects.
You'll serve as the primary connection between account teams and ad builders, ensuring work is delivered accurately, efficiently, and on schedule.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Own the ad build queue, primarily on Meta, from intake through final delivery
Prioritize incoming requests and manage deadlines
Assign projects across the build team and monitor progress
Perform quality assurance reviews on completed builds before launch
Ensure campaign structures, naming conventions, and platform requirements are met
Communicate status updates and launch readiness to stakeholders
Partner closely with account leads and operations teams to maintain execution quality
Opportunity for overtime pay at x rate based on client needs

Requirements

1+ year of Meta ad trafficking, building, or ad operations experience
Strong organizational and prioritization skills
Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication skills and ability to stay calm under deadline pressure
Understanding of campaign structure and QA best practices

Our interview process includes, but is not limited to the following:

Cognitive Aptitude, Excel and Typing Test
Logic assessment on Excel

We offer a competitive salary and benefits based on ability level, including:

Base salary DOE
This is a fully remote role, must be based in Colombia

WITHIN
is the world's first Performance Branding company, partnering with some of the biggest brands in the world to drive business growth through innovative marketing strategies. Our integrated operating model collapses the traditional marketing silos between creative and media, performance and brand, and across media channels. Client teams at WITHIN are trained on how to always act as a trusted business partner, acting as a fiduciary to client needs above our own.
Teams at WITHIN have the ability to work with iconic brands such as The North Face, Timberland, Ben and Jerry's and Jose Cuervo. Everyone at WITHIN wants to grow and be challenged.
