new_jobs.description:
Job Number: R0247700

Mission Operations Analyst and Planner

The Opportunity:

As an expert in defense missions, your unique background inspires you to think bigger, push further, and ask questions others don’t. We need your extensive industry knowledge and advisory skills to solve some of our clients’ most complex problems—and find solutions that keep our nation safe.

As a Mission Operations Analyst and Planner ,
you’ll bring your technical expertise to work alongside thought leaders in analyzing, designing and planning mission operations on projects for a high-profile customer.

You’ll use your skills and expertise to conduct highly responsive mission planning support services as a part of a dedicated, client-site operational support team that enables the execution of dynamic mission requirements on a global basis. Develop and coordinate tailored mission planning packages, conduct suitability studies for destination airfields, and coordinate diplomatic clearances. Maintain a collaborative relationships to ensure continuous support is provided through the mission planning, execution, and data archiving phases of each mission. Maintain flexible work hours to accommodate all mission scenarios and provide uninterrupted operational support. Provide inputs to monthly mission planning support summaries to convey relevant statistical mission planning support data for client reference. Attend DoW and Industry sponsored mission planning conferences as necessary to remain abreast of advances in mission planning and dispatch processes.

Work with us to help solve our customer's most complex mission area focused challenges.
You served your country—now, continue your mission with us. Further your career while creating mission-forward solutions that matter.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have: 

5+ years of experience with military or industry rated aviation
5+ years of experience with military or industry mission planning, weather, and aircraft operations
5+ years of experience with aircraft performance, airfield suitability, and Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) analysis
Experience with executive airlift or business aviation operations requirements
Ability to obtain a TS/SCI clearance
Bachelor's degree

Nice If You Have: 

Experience with aviation industry-standard scheduling systems, and mission planning software
Experience with archiving post-flight data records
Master's degree

new_jobs.title: Network Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Koniag IT Systems, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Network Operations Analyst to support KITS and our government customer Washington, DC. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.

We offer competitive compensation and an extraordinary benefits package including health, dental and vision insurance, 401K with company matching, flexible spending accounts, paid holidays, three weeks paid time off, and more.

The Network Operations Analyst serves as a frontline operations specialist within CLIENT's enterprise Network Operations Center (NOC), providing continuous 24x7x365 monitoring, event detection, triage, and incident management support across CLIENT's enterprise IT infrastructure. This individual monitors the health and performance of CLIENT's network, infrastructure, and application environments, detects and responds to events and incidents, and ensures timely escalation and resolution in accordance with established procedures and service level objectives.

This role is a shift-based position. The selected individual must be available and willing to work rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, Federal holidays, and during Government closures, inclement weather events, and Continuity of Operations activations.

Key Responsibilities

NOC Monitoring & Event Management:

Perform continuous 24x7 monitoring of CLIENT's enterprise network, infrastructure, application, and cloud environments using Government-provided monitoring and event management tools
Detect, triage, and classify events and incidents in accordance with established priority levels and response procedures
Correlate events across multiple monitoring systems to identify root causes and potential service impacts
Initiate and manage the incident lifecycle from detection through resolution and closure in the ITSM platform
Monitor performance dashboards and alert queues, taking immediate action on anomalies and threshold breaches
Support monitoring of on-premises and cloud environments, including AWS commercial, AWS GovCloud, Microsoft Azure Government, and Microsoft 365

Incident Response & Escalation

Acknowledge Priority 1 critical incidents within 15 minutes of detection in accordance with service level objectives
Execute initial triage and containment steps for network and infrastructure incidents
Escalate incidents to the appropriate Tier 2, Tier 3, or Tier 4 engineering teams in a timely and accurate manner
Maintain clear and continuous communication with impacted stakeholders and the NOC/Service Desk Manager during active incidents
Track and document all incident actions, updates, and resolutions in the ITSM platform
Support Priority 1 incident restoration efforts, contributing to the 4-hour restoration target

ITSM & Knowledge Management

Create, update, and close incident, problem, and change records accurately and in a timely manner in the Government ITSM platform
Follow and contribute to the enterprise knowledge base, using documented procedures and runbooks to guide incident response
Identify recurring issues and escalate to problem management for root cause analysis
Support change management activities by monitoring the environment during scheduled change windows
Maintain accurate shift logs, handoff documentation, and operational notes for each watch period

Shift Operations & Coverage Continuity

Report for all assigned shifts on time and fully prepared to assume watch responsibilities
Execute thorough and documented shift handoffs at each shift change, ensuring the incoming analyst is fully briefed on active incidents, open tickets, and operational status
Maintain 100% coverage continuity by adhering to shift schedules and on-call rotation requirements
Participate in cross-training activities to expand operational capability and support coverage across NOC functions
Support surge operations during major incidents, emergency events, or periods of increased operational tempo

Reporting & Analytics

Contribute to Sprint metrics, NOC performance reporting, and service-level tracking
Provide accurate and timely data for monthly status reports, ITSM metrics dashboards, and Sprint Review demonstrations
Identify trends in event and incident data and communicate findings to the NOC/Service Desk Manager
Support automation and tooling improvements that enhance NOC monitoring and response efficiency

Experience

Required Qualifications:

Minimum 2–4 years of hands-on experience in a Network Operations Center, Security Operations Center, or enterprise IT operations environment
Demonstrated experience with enterprise network and infrastructure monitoring tools and platforms
Experience managing incidents using a formal ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy)
Experience working in a shift-based, 24x7 operations environment
Familiarity with Federal or private-sector enterprise IT environments of comparable scale and complexity

Technical Expertise

Working knowledge of:
Enterprise network monitoring and event management tools
LAN/WAN, routing, switching, and wireless networking fundamentals
Cloud infrastructure monitoring (AWS, Azure)
Microsoft 365 and Azure Government environments
ITSM platforms and ticketing workflows
Incident triage, classification, and escalation procedures
Network performance metrics and threshold monitoring
Basic understanding of Zero Trust Architecture principles

Required Certifications (Must Be Current And Unexpired Throughout Performance)

CompTIA Network+ (required)
CompTIA A+ or equivalent (required)
Additional preferred certifications:
CompTIA Security+
Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
AWS Cloud Practitioner
Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)

Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart’s Catalog Operations team powers the data that makes shopping effortless. Catalog data represents the vast majority of what customers see when they browse, search, and buy. Our quality, coverage, and accuracy directly shape the customer experience. We are an AI-first operations team that builds LLM-driven pipelines and scalable quality programs to create, enrich, and govern product data across the Instacart ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Catalog Operations Analyst II to accelerate our Health and Meals pillar within Online Grocery, one of our top strategic priorities. In this role, you will drive end-to-end data quality and enrichment for health, nutrition, and meal-related attributes, partnering closely with Catalog Engineering, Data Science, Product, and ML, as well as external data providers and BPOs. You’ll join a tight-knit team of 8 who roll up their sleeves, solve creatively, and deliver measurable impact at scale.

This role is based in Canada and is remote-eligible nationwide, with a preference for candidates located in Ontario (ideally Greater Toronto Area) for periodic in-person collaboration.

About The Job

Own data quality outcomes for the Health and Meals pillar by defining accuracy and coverage goals for critical attributes (e.g., nutrition, dietary tags, allergens, preparation/meal context) and driving measurable improvements across the catalog.
Design, test, and operationalize LLM pipelines in partnership with Catalog Engineering and ML, including prompt iterations, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop QA.
Develop robust SQL analyses to monitor health of the catalog, identify root causes, prioritize fixes, and communicate performance and impact to cross-functional stakeholders.
Establish and continuously refine taxonomies, attribute definitions, and normalization standards; author SOPs and quality guidelines that scale across internal teams, external content providers, and BPOs.
Manage day-to-day execution with external vendors and data partners (e.g. BPOs), setting SLAs, creating QA workflows, and implementing sampling plans that improve precision and recall at scale.
Partner with Product, DS, and XFN teams to scope experiments, validate assumptions, and translate insights into roadmaps that elevate discovery, search relevance, and conversion for health and meal oriented use cases.

This is a fast-paced, evolving environment. You’ll thrive if you enjoy ambiguity, take ownership from problem definition through execution, and communicate clearly to align diverse partners on outcomes.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

3+ years of experience in catalog/content operations, data operations, or data quality within e-commerce, marketplace, retail, or a similar high-scale data environment.
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, analytical, or related field (e.g., Data/Information Science, Business, Economics, Statistics) or equivalent practical experience.
Demonstrated success partnering with Engineering, Data Science, and Product to scope requirements and deliver production-scale projects.
Proficiency in SQL (including joins, aggregations, and window functions) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets for analysis, QA sampling, and reporting.
Familiarity with LLMs and prompt design for data extraction, classification, or attribute enrichment, including LLM evaluation and feedback loops.
Hands-on experience defining and managing data quality metrics (e.g., accuracy, precision, recall) and running root cause analyses.
Experience operationalizing workflows with external vendors/BPOs or data providers, including SOPs, SLAs, and multi-step QA processes.

Experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) in your day to day.
Experience with data wrangling, QA automation, and scaling manual processes.

new_jobs.description:
About Berkeley

At the University of California, Berkeley, we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth. We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan, which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride.

Departmental Overview

At UC Berkeley School of Public Health (UCBPH), health equity and social justice are part of our DNA. For more than 75 years, we’ve been pushing boundaries and challenging the status quo. Established in 1943, we are a top-10 national school of public health located on the UC Berkeley campus, comprising six academic divisions, more than 20 graduate programs, and nearly 30 research centers and programs. Our mission is to improve population health, especially for the most vulnerable, and our most cherished values are health as a right; strength through diversity; thinking forward; and impact first. Learn more at: publichealth.berkeley.edu.

The Center for Targeted Machine Learning and Causal Inference (CTML) at UC Berkeley is an interdisciplinary research center for advancing, implementing, and disseminating methodology to address problems arising in public health and clinical medicine. CTML's mission statement is to drive rigorous, transparent, and reproducible science by harnessing cutting-edge causal inference and AI targeted towards robust discoveries, informed decision-making, and improving health.

Position Summary

The Research Data Analyst conducts statistical analyses in support of a domestic HIV prevention research program conducted at three study sites that includes randomized trials and related observational studies. Working under the direction of the lead study statistician, this position implements pre-specified statistical analysis plans in R, contributes analytic content to the drafting of those plans, and prepares tables, figures, and summary reports for study monitoring, manuscripts, and presentations. The Research Data Analyst works routinely with site data managers and study staff at the three sites on data deliveries and analytic requests, exercising judgment within established practices on assignments of moderate scope and complexity.

Application Review Date

The First Review Date for this job is: September 7, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.

Responsibilities

Statistical Analysis - 40%

Implement pre-specified analyses for randomized trials and related studies under the direction of the lead statistician, including descriptive summaries, primary and secondary outcome analyses, and pre-specified sensitivity analyses. Apply established causal inference and machine learning based estimators (for example TMLE and related R packages) using specifications set by the lead statistician. Independently plan and run limited analyses and simulations addressing defined design or power questions.

Analytic Dataset Construction - 20%

Build, document, and maintain pooled analytic datasets from the three site datasets and from Electronic Health Records (EHR) and administrative sources. Write and maintain reproducible derivation code. Specify what is needed from site data managers and verify that delivered data meet analytic requirements.

Analysis Plans and Analytic Documentation - 20%

Contribute to the drafting of statistical analysis plans, including data source descriptions, analytic population and outcome definitions, table and figure shells, and written specification of analyses for review by the lead statistician. Maintain version-controlled code, data dictionaries, and analysis logs so all reported results can be regenerated. Contribute analytic language to protocols and Institutional Review Board (IRB) submissions.

Reporting, Publication, and Presentation Support - 5%

Prepare recurring monitoring reports, DSMB tables, and grant progress reporting for internal study constituents. OUR STORY

TechInsights is the information Platform for the semiconductor industry.

Regarded as the most trusted source of actionable, in-depth intelligence related to semiconductor innovation and surrounding markets, TechInsights’ content informs decision makers and professionals whose success depends on accurate knowledge of the semiconductor industry—past, present, or future.

Over 650 companies and 150,000 users access the TechInsights Platform, the world’s largest vertically integrated collection of unmatched reverse engineering, teardown, and market intelligence in the semiconductor industry. This collection includes detailed circuit analysis, imagery, semiconductor process flows, device teardowns, illustrations, costing and pricing information, forecasts, market analysis, and expert commentary. TechInsights’ customers include the most successful technology companies who rely on TechInsights’ analysis to make informed business, design, and product decisions faster and with greater confidence. For more information, visit www.techinsights.com.

WHY WORK WITH US

Company-sponsored training and development opportunities
Comprehensive benefits package (health, dental, vision, wellness, RRSP/401K Matching, annual fitness reimbursement)
Flexible vacation policy
Trusted device reimbursement program
Community involvement opportunities through charitable alliances: https://www.techinsights.com/community-involvement
Wellness resources and support
Inclusive environment that prioritizes diversity, equity, and accessibility
High-growth company driven by high performance
Expected salary range: $80,000 - $85,000 USD

THE OPPORTUNITY:

TechInsights is looking for a Data Analyst to turn complex market data into strategic insights on pricing trends for materials used in semiconductor device fabrication. In this role, you'll spend most of your time analyzing data from multiple sources to support a product that underlies key revenue generation, while also maintaining data quality, documentation, and pipeline optimization. This is a hands-on role suited to someone resourceful and curious, with strong Excel and analytical skills, who can adapt quickly to new tools and work well in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

What You’ll Do

Analyze data to track evolving prices and emerging trends across a wide range of materials used in semiconductor device production, from raw feedstock to finished products
Implement data standards and use various tools to extract, synthesize, and validate data from different sources
Monitor data quality, troubleshoot issues, and ensure data integrity and consistency across reports
Identify and report on data discrepancies, investigate root causes, and implement remediation and prevention measures
Document data and analyses to support easy knowledge transfer
Identify and troubleshoot data inconsistencies in data sources and models, contributing to better data hygiene and documentation
Assist with designing, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines and ETL processes
Look for opportunities to expand your skillset and identify tools or best practices that benefit the analytics team
Share findings and best practices with the team

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Resourceful and curious, comfortable learning on the fly and thriving in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
Highly proficient in data cleaning and preparation across a variety of tools and techniques, with expert knowledge of Excel and data extrapolation
Familiarity with data modeling and data warehouses
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach problems logically and communicate solutions clearly to team members and managers
Self-starter and quick learner
Experience creating unbiased surveys is an asset
Semiconductor materials or semiconductor manufacturing knowledge is an asset

As part of the recruitment process for this position, you will be required to submit your latest citizenship and/or permanent residency information. This information will be used to comply with U.S. Export Control Laws and Regulations.

WORKING ARRANGEMENT

This is a remote position based in either the US or Europe/UK

Technology knows no bounds, and neither does TechInsights. Bringing together talented humans from different perspectives, backgrounds and abilities is something we take seriously. We’re committed to building an inclusive environment that welcomes you to be your authentic self and allows us to push past the boundaries together.

TechInsights is committed to meeting the needs of people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

AI technology may be used to assist in the screening and assessment of applications for this position. Our recruiters are involved at every stage, and all hiring decisions are made by People and hiring teams.

As part of any recruitment process, TechInsights collects and processes personal data relating to job applicants. We are committed to being transparent about how we collect and use that data and to meeting our data protection obligations. SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company. Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service. With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

Integrity:
Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.
Courage:
We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always.
Together:
The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

Job Summary:

As a Staff Data Analyst
at SmithRx, you’ll play a pivotal role on a high-impact Data team, leading through technical excellence, mentoring emerging talent, and delivering insights that accelerate our mission to make healthcare more affordable & accessible. You’ll have a genuine opportunity to shape our product, business, and people, and reinforce our position as the market leader in the Modern PBM

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Revenue
new_jobs.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

This is a full-time, flexible hybrid position based out of our Oakland, CA office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration. There is no mandate on the number of days required but we encourage employees to come in every week to collaborate.

About This Role

We're hiring a Senior Data Analyst, Revenue
to support our CFO and Finance organization on some of the most complex and consequential analytical problems at Fivetran. This role sits at the intersection of finance, data, and applied mathematics, with a focus on understanding, forecasting, and modeling the economic engine of the business.

You'll develop sophisticated models for revenue attribution, forecasting, customer behavior, and financial performance; build the underlying data infrastructure that powers company-wide reporting; and partner directly with Finance and executive leadership on decisions that shape the business.

This is a highly quantitative role for someone with exceptional numerical intuition, rigorous logical thinking, and an unusually high bar for accuracy. You'll work on problems where small errors can have meaningful downstream consequences, and where the best solution often requires going beyond standard reporting into mathematical modeling, statistical methods, or machine learning.

If you enjoy decomposing ambiguous business problems into precise mathematical frameworks, stress-testing assumptions, and building models that become foundational to how a company operates, this role offers the opportunity to work on some of our hardest analytical challenges.

Technologies You'll Use

SQL (BigQuery / Snowflake)
dbt / dbt State
Looker / LookML
Sigma / Hex / Google Sheets
Claude Code / Codex
Netsuite, CRM, and customer data and billing systems

What You'll Do

Develop sophisticated revenue models. Build, maintain, and improve complex mathematical models used to project, attribute, analyze, and understand Fivetran's revenue, customers, and underlying business drivers. Work in an environment with a strong emphasis on mathematical reasoning, robust logic, numerical precision, and analytical rigor.
Own revenue attribution and financial logic. Design frameworks that accurately connect revenue to customers, products, contracts, usage, and other business dimensions, including complex attribution problems that require careful mathematical treatment.
Build and improve revenue forecasting. Develop models that project revenue and customer behavior using historical trends, leading indicators, statistical methods, and machine learning. Continuously evaluate forecast accuracy and improve model performance over time.
Build scalable analytical infrastructure. Create data models, pipelines, and automated systems that are reliable, optimized, and scalable, enabling timely analytics and reporting for more than 2,000 stakeholders across the company.
Maintain an exceptionally high bar for quality. Develop rigorous validation, testing, and quality-assurance processes for financial data and analytical models. Identify edge cases, challenge assumptions, and ensure outputs can withstand scrutiny from Finance and executive leadership.
Partner closely with Finance leadership. Work directly with the CFO organization and cross-functional leaders to translate complex business questions into analytical frameworks, define business rules, establish metrics and targets, and communicate findings clearly.
Drive executive-level decision making. Conduct high-impact, in-depth analyses that inform company strategy, financial planning, resource allocation, growth initiatives, and other critical business decisions.
Embody ownership and operational excellence. Take responsibility for the correctness and reliability of your work, continuously improve existing systems and methodologies, and raise the analytical bar for the broader team.

Skills We're Looking For

4+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience working across large, complex datasets
Exceptional quantitative ability and numerical intuition, with a strong foundation in mathematics, logic, statistics, and analytical problem-solving
Experience using Looker, Tableau, Sigma, or similar business intelligence and visualization tools
Strong analytical judgment and a track record of translating ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data quality, analytical rigor, and reproducibility
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills; you can make complex findings intuitive and help decision-makers understand not just what is happening, but why it matters and what to do next
Comfort operating in ambiguity, developing hypotheses, and owning analytical problems end-to-end
Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to build trusted relationships with both technical and non-technical partners
A builder mindset: you look beyond answering one-off questions and create frameworks, datasets, and tools that make future decisions faster and better
Passion for using data to improve how organizations attract, develop, and support their people
Experience using analytics to support key business decisions, preferably at a high-growth, SaaS, or B2B product company

The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process.

Oakland Pay Range

$156,082—$195,102.50 USD

Perks and Benefits

100% employer-paid medical insurance*
Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off
RSU stock grants*
Professional development and training opportunities
Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
Monthly cell phone stipend
Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers.
